shadows.name: canvas-preview
shadows.purpose: Lift the artwork preview away from the workspace ground.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate the keyboard-shortcut dialog from the editor.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Give hover and selected controls a quick, quiet response.

narrative.overview: A compact, calm editing surface where sprite artwork stays in focus. Graphite panels reduce glare; clay accents identify active tools and key actions.
keyCharacteristics: Dark work surfaces with tonal separation
Warm clay for active and primary actions

rules.name: The Artifact-First Rule
rules.body: Keep the canvas visually central; editor chrome supports the work.

rules.name: The Clay Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve clay for a primary action, selected state, or meaningful focus.

dos: Keep dimensions and frame indices in monospace.
Pair selection color with a visible outline.
donts: Do not use the Palomin sample character as decoration on unrelated projects.
Do not add heavy shadows to every panel.
